2608.18937.title: MedUAG: Unified Understanding and Generation for Medical Multimodal Models
2608.18937.paper_summary: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving into unified understanding and generation (UAG) frameworks. However, extending these unified paradigms to the medical domain is hindered by: the absence of comprehensive training and evaluation benchmarks, and the lack of broadly validated unified medical model. To address these gaps, we present a comprehensive foundation for medical UAG. First, we construct MedUAGCorpus, the largest unified medical understanding and generation dataset to date, comprising over 6 million instances across 14 imaging modalities. Second, we introduce MedUAGBench, a systematic benchmark that expands medical generation evaluation to 12 diverse tasks under standardized protocols. Finally, leveraging these resources, we develop MedUAG, an end-to-end trained unified medical model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MedUAG achieves strong performance across a wide array of understanding and generation tasks, establishing a competitive baseline and paving the way for next-generation medical multimodal systems.
2608.18937.paper_summary_zh: 近期的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）正迅速演變為統一理解與生成（UAG）框架。<lb/>然而，將這些統一範式擴展到醫療領域受到以下因素的阻礙：缺乏全面的訓練和評估基準，以及缺乏廣泛驗證的統一醫療模型。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一個全面的醫療UAG基礎。<lb/>首先，我們構建了MedUAGCorpus，這是迄今為止最大的統一醫療理解與生成數據集，包含超過600萬個實例，涵蓋14種影像模態。<lb/>其次，我們介紹了MedUAGBench，這是一個系統性的基準，將醫療生成評估擴展到12個多樣化的任務，並在標準化的協議下進行。<lb/>最後，利用這些資源，我們開發了MedUAG，一個端到端訓練的統一醫療模型。<lb/>廣泛的實驗表明，MedUAG在各種理解和生成任務中表現出色，建立了競爭基準，並為下一代醫療多模態系統鋪平了道路。
